_doc: Stages (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md 4.1): region stage key -> ordered maps with one boss and pool rule each, map_seconds (boss delay from map entry), round duration (s), pacing keyframes, bursts, elites. Keyframe numbers (rate = mobs/s, max_alive, hp and speed multipliers) interpolate linearly in time between keyframes; the pool (mob id -> weight) is the one of the last keyframe at or before t. Bursts: every `every` s from `first`, a ring of count_min..count_max mobs (growing with time) around the view, allowed past max_alive up to `hard_cap`. Elites: every `every` s from `first`, one mob of the current pool with hp_mult x HP, exp_mult x EXP and damage_mult x mitigated damage. spawn: overrides of balance.json spawn for this region. exp_mult: EXP multiplier of this stage. note: a line shown on the stage card. region and continent (both required, tier C owner choice #221): the town the player sees as the stage name and the small line above or beside it; they replace the WZ map and street names everywhere. original_life is the map's own spawn list (shown on the stage card). Potions are unlimited on per-kind cooldowns; no potion drops exist (spec #237). Boss summon and revive mob ids are not listed here: they come from the bosses' canonical MobSkill 200 and info/revive data (StageRoster). All numbers tier C (ours).
_tiers: Tier C: owner region keys and map lists, spec #241 (Perion and Kerning City added by spec #253); run tiers from spec #32. Map select fits at most four cards per tier (stage_select.gd MAX_CARDS). Zero-based run tier index; choose one stage from each list.

henesys.name: Henesys Hunting Ground I
henesys._bosses: Tier C: 300 s per map from entry (spec #241); separate HP/contact/attack multipliers, calibrated on training runs 1..60 and 2026. Canonical stats, attack boxes and timing remain in Mob.wz; typical_hp/pdd are illustrative build inputs, not runtime scaling.
henesys._maps: Tier C: owner map order and pool rules, spec #241. Each boss time is relative to map entry; Pig Beach excludes timed Iron Hook; Sanctuary uses Sanctuary Entrance IV ordinary weights.

boss._attacks: tier C: 8 s start-to-start cadence and separate slam scaling; canonical type0 attack300/attackAfter1050ms/range remain unchanged
tier C: contact450 and slam300 receive separate survivor scales calibrated against actual training buildHP; canonical attack values unchanged

henesys._balance29: Tier C: historical coarse #29 pass for the vanilla v83 Beginner (5 MP, one Three Snails shell at canonical MP): a sword-paced opening of a few mobs and generous HP drops until 4:00, no elites before 4:00 or bursts before 5:00, and 2.5x stage EXP so the bot reaches Magician near 4:40. Superseded by the #30 C46 calibration below; Tree stage data unchanged.
henesys._balance30: Tier C: coarse C46 stage data from #30 (training seeds 1..60 and 2026, measured with card weights 86/8/3.5/1.7/0.8; GAME_DESIGN 4.2). Retains v83 opening, later HP pressure/support and late ordinary MP taper. Not re-tuned for the restored spec card odds; tuning waits for the dedicated balance pass.
henesys._post_duration_slope: Tier C: after the last keyframe, continue its rate/max_alive/HP/speed slopes, the burst-size slope and (via the rate ratio) the elite frequency at one quarter pace until every boss dies.
henesys._opening: Tier C: owner choice #241: t0 rate 0.25/cap 6, t120 0.55/11, t180 0.75/15; t240 onward and pools unchanged.

perion._tier: Tier A: map IDs and original_life from v83 Map.wz. Tier C (owner, spec #253): region, map order, boss picks and pool rules; the numeric curve (keyframe rate/max_alive/hp/speed, bursts, elites, exp_mult, hard_cap, post_duration_slope) copies Henesys exactly. The 210 s keyframe is Henesys's curve interpolated at 3:30 (rate 0.875, max_alive 17.5, speed 1.0375), added only to carry the 3:30 pool change; keyframes from 300 s carry no pool because map 1 picks only keyframes with t < 300 (maps 2 and 3 use their own life lists).
perion.name: West Street Corner of Perion
perion._bosses: Tier C (spec #253, starting values, untuned): each boss matches the Henesys boss of the same map slot (Mano, Mushmom, Blue Mushmom) at that slot's typical_hp/typical_pdd: survivor HP = round(canonical maxHP x hp_mult) equals the slot's, and hp_mult/dmg_mult/attack_dmg_mult are the 0.01 steps whose 85-100% roll range (CombatMath.monster_damage) lies closest to the slot's touch/attack roll range. Canonical PDD/MDD, level and undead flags are not normalized.

sleepywood._tier: Tier A: map ID and original_life from v83 Map.wz. Tier C: owner roster/order, 900 s duration, all pacing values, pool weights, EXP, burst and elite settings; first-pass data chosen before measurement for arriving Lv35-43 second-job characters, not calibrated (#77). Tauromacis/Taurospear use their canonical attacks (#76; cadence in balance.json mob_attacks).
